description: This file defines the EntityTypeManager class in Drupal, responsible for managing entity type plugin definitions, including loading, processing, and providing handlers for entity types.

classes.name: EntityTypeManager
classes.description: Manages entity type plugin definitions, including loading, processing, and providing handlers for entity types within Drupal.

methods.name: processDefinition
methods.description: Validates and processes an entity type definition, ensuring link templates start with a slash.

methods.name: findDefinitions
methods.description: Discovers and processes all entity type definitions, invoking hooks and applying alterations.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves the definition of a specific entity type by ID, optionally throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: getActiveDefinition
methods.description: Returns the active definition for a content entity type, considering the last installed schema.

methods.name: clearCachedDefinitions
methods.description: Clears cached entity type definitions and handler cache.

methods.name: useCaches
methods.description: Enables or disables caching for entity type definitions and handlers.

methods.name: hasHandler
methods.description: Checks if a specific handler exists for an entity type.

methods.name: getStorage
methods.description: Returns the storage handler for an entity type.

methods.name: getListBuilder
methods.description: Returns the list builder handler for an entity type.

methods.name: getFormObject
methods.description: Retrieves the form object for a given operation on an entity type, validating class existence and interface implementation.

methods.name: getRouteProviders
methods.description: Returns route provider handlers for an entity type.

methods.name: getViewBuilder
methods.description: Returns the view builder handler for an entity type.

methods.name: getAccessControlHandler
methods.description: Returns the access control handler for an entity type.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Retrieves a specific handler for an entity type, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: createHandlerInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of a handler class, injecting dependencies if applicable.
